provenance.boundary_rule: component j=0..n-1 is (j+1)+((j mod5)-2)i, exact integers
provenance.endpoint_selection: Smallest power of two R>=4 enclosing both computed pole sets in |eta|<R/4; straight segment -2Ri to -Ri.
provenance.scope: Actual sampled paper-family differential matrix; deterministic supplied boundary vector is not a physical integral boundary.
